The Clinical Nurse Educator position is within the UC Davis Department of Pediatrics within the Division of Developmental and Behavioral Pediatrics and housed at the UC Davis MIND Institute. The position supports the UC Davis PATH (Promoting Accessibility to Healthcare) Program.
70% - Clinical Education Program Leadership and Systems Consultation

The Clinical Nurse Educator serves as the clinical education lead for the Promoting Accessibility to Healthcare (PATH) program, a health system-wide initiative designed to improve the care experience, accessibility, and health outcomes of children and adolescents with neurodevelopmental conditions. The primary goals for the PATH RN Clinical Nurse Educator are to increase patient and staff satisfaction, optimize neuroinclusive care and improve health outcomes for patients with neurodevelopmental conditions. The incumbent provides expert leadership in the development, implementation, and evaluation of evidence-based educational programs and training strategies for interdisciplinary healthcare professionals across inpatient and outpatient settings.
10% - Nursing Process and Practice Advocacy

In collaboration with clinical, operational, and community stakeholders, the Clinical Nurse Educator designs and delivers neuroinclusive education, develops training resources and implementation strategies, evaluates program outcomes, and supports the dissemination of best practices throughout UC Davis Health. The incumbent participates in unit environmental assessments and serves as a liaison with the PATH Advisory Committee. The role also serves as a clinical resource and consultant on evidence-based approaches to supporting patients with neurodevelopmental conditions and may provide limited care coordination support related to PATH program initiatives.
10% - Clinical Care Coordination and Navigation
This position functions with a high degree of autonomy and advanced clinical expertise to promote excellence in patient care, staff development, and organizational learning.
